newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Torrential rains cause T$1 bln losses in Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: Torrential rains cause T$1 bln losses in Taiwan.

text.p: Torrential, sustained rains since June 4 have severely damaged Taiwan's farms, forests, crops and livestock, with losses hitting T$1 billion by Monday, the cabinet's Council of Agriculture said.
"The (agricultural) losses have reached T$1 billion," a council official told Reuters by telephone.
Rains had flooded farmland in many areas, prompting the government to respond with offers of immediate emergency assistance.
The central county of Miaoli was hardest hit with losses surpassing T$300 million, the official said.
Prices of some fruits and vegetables had surged, with some retail prices on Monday as much as 40 percent higher than they were before the rains began, he said.
The farm council urged local governments to offer assistance and subsidies to farmers who had suffered rain-related losses.
Qualified farmers will receive cash subsidies equalling 10-20 percent of the production costs of their damaged crops and can apply for low-cost loans of up to T$3 million to restore farms.
